Name: ChefRudes Rats for CP
Author: chefrude
Description:
[size=5]Add Rats to your Farm! 
[/size]
﻿[size=4]A [s]Better Farm Animal Variety[/s] Content Patcher mod that adds Rats to the game. Rats come in a variety of colors, and scavenge trash daily. On rare occasions, you might get a piece of cheese...
[/size][size=4][i]
How to Install[/i]
[/size]• Download and install the latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
• Download and unzip "[CP] ChefRudes Rats"
• Drag the entire folder into your [i]\Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder
[/i][i]
[/i]The only thing left to do is enjoy your cute little scavenger friends!

A lot of thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/34471635]Meggiee [/url]for updating the files for SDV 1.6 and Content Patcher :)

Downloads.Description: Removed old references to BFAV in the content and updated the rats to have unique icons in the shop, supporting Live Stock Choices, also included the missing update key

Manifest.Description: Adds a variety of resourceful Rats to the game.
